title: Kubhururuka Mugungwa Risingaperi
intro: Fungidzira wakamira padheki rechikepe chakazara nemhepo sezvo mafungu achikwira uye vashandi vachikanda mijenya kuti mutoro ureruke. Munhu ari ega anofamba achienda mberi, achigamuchira mugumo unoita semugumo, asi pasi rose pachava nzvimbo yekunamatira nekudzoka. Kumashure kune nharaunda yanyeverwa nezvekurangwa kuri kuuya, mberi kune tsitsi dzisingatarisirwi.
clues: Ndakatumwa semutumwa kuvanhu vanopfuura zviuru zana.
Ndakasiya vanhu vangu ndakatsamwa ndisati ndapihwa mvumo yekubva.
Ndakakwira ngarava yakanga yakazara zvinhu uye vashandi vakakanda mijenya kuti vasarudze kuti ndiani aizokandirwa mumvura.
Ndakakandwa mugungwa ndikamedzwa nehove huru asi ini ndaifanira kupomerwa mhosva.
Ndakarumbidza Allah murima, ndichiti hakuna mwari kunze kwake uye kuti ndaiva mumwe wevanoita zvakaipa.
Ndakakandwa pamhenderekedzo yegungwa, ndichirwara, uye Allah akaita kuti muti wemupunga ukure pamusoro pangu, vanhu vangu vakatenda uye vakakomborerwa kwenguva yakati.
